# Auserene

> Auserene is an AI journaling app for iPhone that remembers what helps you. You write short notes during the day, talk the day through with Auserene in the evening, and it turns the conversation into a journal entry and a personalized meditation made from your own words. It is currently in beta on iPhone.

Auserene is not therapy and does not diagnose. It is made by Himanshu Pathak, who built it after journaling with a therapist helped him through a year of anxiety.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS) only, for now
- Pricing: free tier; Premium is $105.99/year, $11.99/month, or $4.99/week, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan
- Memory: everything Auserene knows about you is listed in plain sentences in the app's You tab, where you can edit or delete it
- Privacy: entries are encrypted with a key tied to your account; our AI model provider works under a zero-data-retention contract, keeps nothing after a reply, and is contractually barred from training on your content; no ads or ad trackers; you can delete your account and all data from inside the app

## Blog

Research-backed articles. Every claim links to its source.

- [Journaling statistics: what the research shows](https://www.auserene.com/blog/journaling-statistics): Journaling, worry, sleep, meditation and habit statistics, each checked against the original study: effect sizes, app retention, and what actually helps.
- [Does journaling actually help? What the research shows](https://www.auserene.com/blog/does-journaling-work): Journaling actually helps, but modestly: trials show small drops in stress, anxiety and low mood. Here's which kind of writing works and which backfires.
- [Journaling for anxiety: write it down, then check it](https://www.auserene.com/blog/journaling-for-anxiety): How to journal for anxiety: note each worry in one line, then check it that evening. In trials, about 9 in 10 feared outcomes never happened.
- [Racing thoughts at night: what actually quiets them](https://www.auserene.com/blog/racing-thoughts-at-night): Racing thoughts at night come in three kinds. What sleep research says works for each: a specific to-do list, an earlier worry hour, and getting up.
- [Rumination vs reflection: how to stop ruminating](https://www.auserene.com/blog/rumination-vs-reflection): How to stop ruminating: step back before you ask why, ask how when you're close, write it down, and end with one step. What the research on reflection shows.
- [Naming emotions: what affect labeling can and can't do](https://www.auserene.com/blog/name-your-feelings): Naming emotions (affect labeling) lowers distress a little, right away. What the research shows, when it backfires, and how to track moods usefully.
- [Evening reflection questions, and the order to ask them](https://www.auserene.com/blog/evening-reflection-questions): Evening reflection questions that settle the day: what happened, how it felt, what went well, what's open, and tomorrow's first step. With the research.
- [Personalized meditation: does it beat generic apps?](https://www.auserene.com/blog/personalized-meditation): Personalized meditation uses your own day and name instead of one recording for everyone. What the research says, why apps lose users, and how to try it.
- [Using ChatGPT as a journal: what it keeps and what helps](https://www.auserene.com/blog/chatgpt-as-a-journal): Using ChatGPT as a journal can work if you change a few settings. What OpenAI keeps as of October 2026, why agreeable chatbots backfire, and what to ask.
- [How to make a habit stick: what habit studies show](https://www.auserene.com/blog/habits-that-stick): To make a habit stick, tie one small action to a moment you already have, write an if-then plan, and give it about two months. Here is what the studies show.
- [Handwriting vs typing a journal: what research shows](https://www.auserene.com/blog/paper-vs-digital-journal): Handwriting vs typing a journal: 146 studies found no difference in benefit between pen, keyboard or voice. Here's what matters more and how to choose.
- [Best AI journal apps: an honest comparison for 2026](https://www.auserene.com/blog/best-ai-journal-apps): The best AI journal apps compared from each company's own pages, October 2026: Rosebud, Day One, Mindsera, Stoic, Apple Journal, ChatGPT and more.
- [30 journal prompts for overthinking, sorted by the loop](https://www.auserene.com/blog/journal-prompts-for-overthinking): Journal prompts for overthinking that end the loop: 30 concrete questions sorted by kind of overthinking, each with a follow-up and the research behind it.
- [What to write in a journal: 7 simple formats](https://www.auserene.com/blog/what-to-write-in-a-journal): What to write in a journal: one thing that stuck with you, how it felt and why. Seven simple formats with example entries, plus what to write on blank days.
